In a vertical cylinder, wind vertically upward from the bottom can "blow" tourists up, letting people experience the feeling of floating in space. Suppose that the wind speeds at all positions in the wind tunnel are the same and remain unchanged. It is known that the magnitude of the wind force on the human body is proportional to the area facing the wind; when lying horizontally, the wind-facing area is the largest; when standing, the wind-facing area is the smallest, being 1/8 of the maximum value; when the human body makes an inclination angle with the vertical direction and the wind-facing area is 1/2 of the maximum value, the person can just remain stationary or drift at uniform speed. In a certain performance, a performer of mass m keeps a standing posture and starts to fall from rest from point A, which is at a height H from the bottom; when passing point B, he immediately adjusts his posture to lying horizontally and maintains it; when reaching point C at the bottom, his speed is just reduced to zero. Then in the process from A to C, which of the following statements is correct ( )
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The work done by the performer overcoming the wind force from A to B is 1/6 of the work done overcoming the wind force from B to C

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The diagram in the question schematically shows that in a vertical cylindrical wind tunnel there is upward wind at the bottom, and the performer falls from the upper point A, changes posture when passing point B, and has speed zero at the bottom point C; A, B, and C are arranged along the vertical direction. According to the meaning of the question, when the wind-facing area is 1/2 of the maximum value, the person can remain stationary or drift at uniform speed, indicating that the wind force at this time is equal to the weight mg. The wind force is proportional to the wind-facing area, so the horizontal-lying wind force corresponding to the maximum wind-facing area is F_max=2mg; the wind-facing area when standing is 1/8 of the maximum value, so the wind force when standing is F_站=F_max/8=mg/4. Let the distance AB be x and the distance BC be y. From A to B, the person keeps standing and falls; gravity is downward mg, the wind force is upward mg/4, the resultant force is downward mg-mg/4=3mg/4, and the acceleration a1=3g/4; from rest to B, v_B^2=2a1x=2*(3g/4)x. From B to C, the posture is changed to lying horizontally; the wind force is upward 2mg, gravity is downward mg, and the resultant force is upward mg, so during the downward motion the magnitude of the deceleration is g; when reaching C the speed is zero, so v_B^2=2gy. Combining gives 2*(3g/4)x=2gy, therefore y=3x/4. Taking the work done overcoming the wind force as the magnitude of the work of the wind force opposing the downward displacement: W_AB=(mg/4)x, W_BC=(2mg)y. Therefore W_AB/W_BC=[(mg/4)x]/[2mg*(3x/4)]=1/6.

method.method_draft: 用分段动能定理而不先求加速度。由面积为最大值的1/2时恰好平衡得F_max/2=mg，所以水平横躺风力为2mg，站立风力为mg/4。设AB距离为x，BC距离为y，B点动能为K。A到B段：重力做正功mgx，风力做负功-(mg/4)x，初动能为0，所以K=mgx-(mg/4)x=3mgx/4。B到C段：从动能K变为0，重力做正功mgy，水平横躺风力做负功-2mgy，因此0-K=mgy-2mgy=-mgy，得K=mgy。于是mgy=3mgx/4，即y=3x/4。两段克服风力做功分别为(mg/4)x和2mg·y，代入位移比得到W_AB/W_BC=1/6。
method.CoT_raw:
按分段动能定理求解，不先求加速度。已知风力大小与正对风面积成正比。当受风面积为最大值的1/2时，人恰好静止或匀速漂移，说明此时风力等于重力：F_max/2 = mg，所以水平横躺时最大风力F_max = 2mg。站立时受风面积为最大值的1/8，因此站立时风力为F_stand = F_max/8 = mg/4。

设AB段下降距离为x，BC段下降距离为y，B点动能为K。

A到B段：表演者站立下落，重力做正功mgx，风力向上、位移向下，风力做负功-(mg/4)x。由动能定理：K - 0 = mgx - (mg/4)x = 3mgx/4，所以K = 3mgx/4。

B到C段：表演者水平横躺，风力为2mg。重力做正功mgy，风力做负功-2mgy。到C点速度减为零，所以动能从K变为0。由动能定理：0 - K = mgy - 2mgy = -mgy，因此K = mgy。

联立K = 3mgx/4和K = mgy，得y = 3x/4。

两段克服风力做的功分别等于风力做负功的大小：W_AB = (mg/4)x，W_BC = 2mg·y。代入y = 3x/4，得W_BC = 2mg·(3x/4) = 3mgx/2。因此W_AB/W_BC = [(mg/4)x]/(3mgx/2) = 1/6。

A到B段：表演者站立下落，重力做正功mgx，风力向上、位移向下，风力做负功-(mg/4)x。由动能定理：K - 0 = mgx - (mg/4)x = 3mgx/4，所以K = 3mgx/4。

B到C段：表演者水平横躺，风力为2mg。重力做正功mgy，风力做负功-2mgy。到C点速度减为零，所以动能从K变为0。由动能定理：0 - K = mgy - 2mgy = -mgy，因此K = mgy。

联立K = 3mgx/4和K = mgy，得y = 3x/4。

两段克服风力做的功分别等于风力做负功的大小：W_AB = (mg/4)x，W_BC = 2mg·y。代入y = 3x/4，得W_BC = 2mg·(3x/4) = 3mgx/2。因此W_AB/W_BC = [(mg/4)x]/(3mgx/2) = 1/6。

raw_record.original_question: “娱乐风洞”是一种惊险的娱乐项目。在竖直的圆筒内，从底部竖直向上的风可把游客“吹”起来，让人体验太空飘浮的感觉。假设风洞内各位置的风速均相同且保持不变，已知人体所受风力的大小与正对风的面积成正比，水平横躺时受风面积最大，站立时受风面积最小、为最大值的1/8；当人体与竖直方向成一倾角、受风面积是最大值的1/2时，人恰好可静止或匀速漂移。在某次表演中，质量为m的表演者保持站立身姿从距底部高为H的A点由静止开始下落；经过B点时，立即调整身姿为水平横躺并保持；到达底部的C点时速度恰好减为零。问：从A到B表演者克服风力做的功与从B到C克服风力做的功之比是多少？
raw_record.answer: The work done by the performer overcoming the wind force from A to B is 1/6 of the work done overcoming the wind force from B to C
raw_record.final_cot: The diagram in the question schematically shows that in a vertical cylindrical wind tunnel there is upward wind at the bottom, and the performer falls from the upper point A, changes posture when passing point B, and has speed zero at the bottom point C; A, B, and C are arranged along the vertical direction. According to the meaning of the question, when the wind-facing area is 1/2 of the maximum value, the person can remain stationary or drift at uniform speed, indicating that the wind force at this time is equal to the weight mg. The wind force is proportional to the wind-facing area, so the horizontal-lying wind force corresponding to the maximum wind-facing area is F_max=2mg; the wind-facing area when standing is 1/8 of the maximum value, so the wind force when standing is F_站=F_max/8=mg/4. Let the distance AB be x and the distance BC be y. From A to B, the person keeps standing and falls; gravity is downward mg, the wind force is upward mg/4, the resultant force is downward mg-mg/4=3mg/4, and the acceleration a1=3g/4; from rest to B, v_B^2=2a1x=2*(3g/4)x. From B to C, the posture is changed to lying horizontally; the wind force is upward 2mg, gravity is downward mg, and the resultant force is upward mg, so during the downward motion the magnitude of the deceleration is g; when reaching C the speed is zero, so v_B^2=2gy. Combining gives 2*(3g/4)x=2gy, therefore y=3x/4. Taking the work done overcoming the wind force as the magnitude of the work of the wind force opposing the downward displacement: W_AB=(mg/4)x, W_BC=(2mg)y. Therefore W_AB/W_BC=[(mg/4)x]/[2mg*(3x/4)]=1/6.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: "Entertainment wind tunnel" is a thrilling entertainment project. In a vertical cylinder, wind vertically upward from the bottom can "blow" tourists up, letting people experience the feeling of floating in space. Suppose that the wind speeds at all positions in the wind tunnel are the same and remain unchanged. It is known that the magnitude of the wind force on the human body is proportional to the area facing the wind; when lying horizontally, the wind-facing area is the largest; when standing, the wind-facing area is the smallest, being 1/8 of the maximum value; when the human body makes an inclination angle with the vertical direction and the wind-facing area is 1/2 of the maximum value, the person can just remain stationary or drift at uniform speed. In a certain performance, a performer of mass m keeps a standing posture and starts to fall from rest from point A, which is at a height H from the bottom; when passing point B, he immediately adjusts his posture to lying horizontally and maintains it; when reaching point C at the bottom, his speed is just reduced to zero. Question: What is the ratio of the work done by the performer overcoming the wind force from A to B to the work done overcoming the wind force from B to C?
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer: The work done by the performer overcoming the wind force from A to B is 1/6 of the work done overcoming the wind force from B to C
